verdict.rationale: JumpCloud publishes a first-party API spec (index.yaml under docs.jumpcloud.com/api) describing its REST endpoints, and an official GitHub support repo provides API example scripts, so an API reference and examples exist. Nothing shows the reference is interactive or that examples can be run in-browser, and probes for an OpenAPI JSON and markdown docs returned 404. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive API explorer, in-page runnable/'try it' examples, an accessible machine-readable OpenAPI endpoint, hands-on corroboration.
